# Aggregat

> Index and agent knowledge base for community firmware, mods and tools on Elektron devices: 275 projects, 1320 hardware facts with evidence tags, 118 rules for agents, 107 incidents on real units and 24 bugs in Elektron's own OS. Metadata only, no firmware. CC0.

Everything is second-hand; re-check addresses against the cited source. Evidence: [hw] real unit, [emu] emulator only, [doc] stated without a test, [?] inferred. Safety rules A1-A49 apply to every flash.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/70b185/Aggregat/master/AGENTS.md): how agents should use this repository
- [Agent rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/70b185/Aggregat/master/hardware/AGENT-RULES.md): safety, legal and process rules, each with its evidence
- [Stock bugs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/70b185/Aggregat/master/hardware/STOCK-BUGS.md): bugs in Elektron's OS, check before blaming a mod
- [Incidents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/70b185/Aggregat/master/hardware/INCIDENTS.md): what went wrong on real units and the rule it taught

## Data
- [SQLite database](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/70b185/Aggregat/master/export/aggregat.sqlite): all tables with full-text search over facts
- [JSON export](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/70b185/Aggregat/master/export/aggregat.json): the same tables as JSON
- [Export schema and example queries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/70b185/Aggregat/master/export/README.md)
- [MCP server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/70b185/Aggregat/master/mcp/README.md): query tools for agents

## Optional
- [Research map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/70b185/Aggregat/master/research/RESEARCH-MAP.md): what is known and open per device, shared goals
- [Feature overlap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/70b185/Aggregat/master/research/FEATURE-OVERLAP.md): the same feature built on several devices
- [Address map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/70b185/Aggregat/master/hardware/ADDRESS-MAP.md): every address named in a fact, per device
- [RAM tenancy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/70b185/Aggregat/master/hardware/RAM-TENANCY.md): which mod platform uses which RAM range
- [Website](https://70b185.github.io/Aggregat/): search, mods by device, network map
